scenario: [LSER.16.3.3] / [LSER.16.3.1]: on `sample` (SeriesBackendReservoir, [LSMP.2.3]) the sample forms `variance` and `stdev` are `null` when the bag holds one sample, and `pvariance` / `pstdev` are +0. `sample 3` with values 1.0, 3.0, 4.0, one per pump, so the bag only fills ([LSMP.2.1]); each read is pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]), so pump 1 is cold, pump 2 reads one sample and pump 3 two. The guards make one message per warm read: `null at one` from pump 2 (`count` is 1; `variance` and `stdev` null; `pvariance` and `pstdev` +0), then `warm at two` from pump 3, where `variance` and `stdev` have a value again (over [1, 3]: `variance` 2.0). PATH PINNED: libds `series/reservoir.c` `ds_series_reservoir_query`'s `DS_SERIES_AGG_VARIANCE` / `_STDEV` arms, and Mercury `ds.series.moment`'s `mf_reservoir` form.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Float mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    count, variance, stdev, pvariance, pstdev sample 3

rule at_one:
    Reading s where s.count == 1 and s.variance is null and s.stdev is null and s.pvariance == 0.0 and s.pstdev == 0.0
->
    log info "null at one"

rule at_two:
    Reading s where s.count == 2 and s.variance == 2.0 and s.stdev is not null
->
    log info "warm at two"
